title: THEN / NOW
rule: every row is one change made to a product: an earlier state stays grey, a problem has only its measured part struck while its result writes in, and a new product says Shipped with its Result
description: Eight changes, a live product first. The identity line says the idea: Gentrit Rashiti builds web and mobile apps, and rebuilds and fixes the ones people already use; the sub-line gives the level (5+ years) and keeps 'Part of two platform rewrites'. Row 01 is Bayyinah TV: version 1 in grey, then 'Built again: members subscribe on the web, iPhone or Android' writes in, and the line rings the Start 7-Day Free Trial button on the live pricing page. Row 02, also on the first screen at 1440, is the billing report: only '16 times and gave up' is struck when the row becomes current, 'It asks 2 times and finishes' writes in, and a blue diagram strikes 16 and writes 2. Only two rows strike (the billing report and the studio site's 972 KB), because only they have a measured problem that is gone. The care platform shows its 2023 app in grey and 'Most screens are already rebuilt in React', with the note that a screen moves over only after it passes the same tests in both apps. Design System v2 is 'Built ... with the team' and its result is '96.6% less JavaScript for a page that uses only a button', drawn to scale, not struck. Read to Feed, Viva Fresh and Incentiv say Shipped and Result.
signature: Literata for every sentence and Anton for the labels (THEN, NOW, SHIPPED, RESULT, BUILT), the row numbers, the tray and the two diagrams; ink #121212 on paper #F6F5F0, earlier and problem text #57544C (6.9:1), struck part #6B6860 (5.0:1), one accent #2348D8 for the NOW band, the hairline, the ring and the two diagram plates (white on accent 7.5:1, soft white 4.7:1). Desktop: a 1344 px grid with 48 px gutters, the log at the left and a 640 x 560 frame at the right, sticky at 96 px. Every plate fills the 640 x 560 stage: web screens at 0.73 to 1.0, phone screens at 0.95 to 1.0, the two diagrams laid out in cqw so one rule draws the desktop and the phone plate. A row becomes current when its top passes 42% of the viewport and settles for 160 ms. A fixed row's struck part draws its line on every wrapped line at once (200 ms), the NOW band wipes in by clip-path (260 ms, after 200 ms), then the hairline draws from the band end into the frame (180 ms) and the ring fades in (120 ms). The line waits for the band's transitionend. Plates cross-fade in 200 ms. Keyboard jumps (arrows, Home, End, tray, Tab) are instant, including the diagram parts. The text waits at most 300 ms for its two faces; if they are late, the page keeps metric-matched fallback faces (Georgia and Impact with size-adjust and ascent overrides) for the visit, so a late font never moves a line. Phone: the frame pins at the top at 4:3, at most 436 px wide (the narrowest crop), with phone crops and the ring only. Reduced motion: every fixed row is struck from the start, the band and ring appear at once, and nothing moves.
holdback: Lowest: original, 7/10. The frame is projector's sticky frame beside a scrolling log, and the strike-and-write is year-stack's; the new part is that only the measured part of a problem is struck. Other limits: the strike no longer plays at load, because row 01 is now a live product with an earlier state (no problem to strike); the 16 -> 2 strike plays on the first scroll, and row 02 is on the first screen at 1440 as text. First-screen chroma is 3.7% (the pricing page is dark with red buttons); the blue diagram plates bring 26-27% when rows 02 and 06 are current. Two rows have no pin, because no pixel proves the result (care platform rebuild, Snaxx Tech image weight). The Bayyinah TV pin proves the subscription button, not the 34 pages. A visitor whose fonts arrive after 300 ms sees Georgia and Impact for that visit (metric-matched, CLS 0). Design System v2 is a team project and its dashboard is not in production; the row says 'with the team' and makes no live claim.

Plates fill the frame: the stage is 640 x 560; the billing figure is two rows (before 16 struck with 16 squares, now 2 with 2 squares); the half-empty button card is replaced by a bundle diagram drawn to scale (3.4% bar, 96.6% less); every crop re-cut to whole UI parts
